PyRosetta-4 2026 [Rosetta PyRosetta4.conda.m1.cxx11thread.serialization.python311.Release 2026.06+release.1a56185c2592611dec4c9c75ddc9468cd2227c1f 2026-01-30T13:14:27] retrieved from: http://www.pyrosetta.org

enrollment_protocol_excerpt.selection: first two VAL/first two THR in file order, consecutive two-target groups; three mask classes; no outcome filtering
enrollment_protocol_excerpt.candidate_gate: unchanged mixed individual/raw-joint/rounded/global stereo guards; no scoring rescue
enrollment_protocol_excerpt.selection_policy: minimum full-pose ref2015 over every old-gate-feasible joint combination; stable enumeration tie; any missing feasible score blocks selection
baselines: independent per-target clearance choices, which may fail joint guards
existing raw-joint-clearance choice with canonical rounded materialization
enrollment_protocol_excerpt.coupling_diagnostic: E(i,j)-E(i,j0)-E(i0,j)+E(i0,j0); reference is lexicographically first source-feasible indices, never native; full Cartesian score matrix required; a single-option axis is uninformative
enrollment_protocol_excerpt.scope: previously studied systems/constituents; new joint mechanisms only, not independent prospective accuracy validation

score_policy.hydrogen_protocol: fresh import for each rounded heavy candidate; no H optimization; no repack or minimization
score_policy.virtual_atom_policy: typed virtual atoms are separate scorer-owned pseudoatoms, retained in snapshots; never exempt an input atom by name
score_policy.extra_heavy_policy: only unobserved OXT on Rosetta upper termini without declared outgoing C peptide link
score_policy.selection_policy: minimum total score over complete old-source-and-common-gate-feasible own pool; stable index tie; any missing feasible score blocks selection
score_policy.native_policy: native controls scored after own selection committed; never eligible for selection
score_policy.topology_scope: source-derived external links and canonical target internal bonds; not a complete independent context internal bond-order audit

scope: exhaustive small matrices on previously studied systems; not interaction-graph approximation, global conformational optimum or independent-family validation
